traits.name: Water-Bound
traits.text: When not touching water, the living waterfall is slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

traits.name: Vortex
traits.text: (aura, water); 30 feet. Water in the area that is in the same body of water as the living waterfall is difficult terrain for Swimming creatures that don't have the water trait.

traits.name: Drench
traits.text: ⬻ (abjuration, primal, water); The elemental puts out all fires in a 5-foot emanation. It extinguishes all non-magical fires automatically and attempts to counteract magical fires (+14 counteract modifier).

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ wave +15 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+7 (2d8+7) bludgeoning plus Push or Pull 5 feet
